modules.name: Open HVAC Bridge Core
modules.summary: Multi-vendor local Modbus, USB, BACnet and M-Bus bridge. Ouman USB protocol reader bundled.
modules.caution: OpenLVI multi-vendor drivers are experimental; the included Ouman USB reader must not be configured twice on one port.

modules.name: Mango Tuya Local VILP
modules.summary: LAN-local Tuya 3.5 heat pump integration; 770 model-specific parameter routes.
modules.caution: Captured Mango Energy profile only. Most writes have not been physically verified. Local device key required.

modules.name: Ouman EH-800B Legacy
modules.summary: Separate EH-800B USB implementation v0.1.2 verified on one controller.
modules.caution: YAML setup required; PID and manual valve writes can be hazardous. Do not poll the same USB port using multiple integrations.

modules.name: CO2 Ventilation Blueprints
modules.summary: Shelly 0-10 V supplemental ventilation and sustained CO2 alert blueprints.
modules.caution: Auxiliary ventilation only. Not a replacement for mandatory air-handling or fire-safety controls.

modules.name: OpenLVI SCADA Dashboard
modules.summary: Read-only isometric Lovelace SCADA card and example configuration.
modules.caution: Custom card and example must be installed separately; sample entities require replacing.

modules.name: ESP32-S3 Ouman Demo
modules.summary: ESP32-S3 dashboard prototype and setup documentation.
modules.caution: Prototype. Not a safety controller or production-ready bridge.

modules.name: Jäspi Tehowatti Dry Contact
modules.summary: Local ESPHome relay example for the traditional Tehowatti electric boiler's NO temperature-setback contact.
modules.target: manual (ESPHome firmware on separate ESP32 and isolated NO relay)
modules.caution: Only the existing temperature setback input; electrical wiring requires qualified verification. No internal registers or safety bypass.

modules.name: Roth Touchline PL Relay Monitor
modules.summary: ESPHome read-only monitoring of the unused, isolated Roth Touchline PL heat-source relay output (NO/COM); not a zone control driver.
modules.target: manual (separate ESP32, qualified and electrically isolated dry-contact wiring)
modules.caution: Strictly passive and read-only. DO NOT connect ESP32 to 230 V zone outputs, pump supply or existing energized boiler circuits. No Modbus/API support is claimed.

modules.name: DEVIreg 330 price setback blueprint
modules.summary: Per-circuit Home Assistant spot-price setback automation for independently commissioned DEVIreg 330 (+5 to +45 C) external timer inputs.
modules.caution: No Modbus on DEVIreg 330. The external timer input is mains-referenced; install a correctly rated and physically fail-safe relay through qualified electrical work. Restores normal mode on stale prices but cannot protect against HA outages.

modules.name: Open HVAC Ouflex
modules.summary: Ouman Ouflex app-specific Modbus integration: read-only automatic FTP Ounet XML point map import and register browser; protected writes only after verification.
modules.caution: FTP autoload requires anonymous read access on private LAN and per-device Ounet XML. Writes disabled until separately physically verified.
